setup: Server clock: local date 2026-11-18 unless a step sets another (fixed time zone, e.g. TZ=America/New_York). LITTLEBUDDY_DATA_DIR = a new temp dir holding only the case's files; TTS_VOICE unset (03 §5, REQ-073: tests do not set it); Wi-Fi off; an isolated instance (own PORT and BONSAI_PORT, never the user's 4317). 'restart' = stop the server, npm start again. 'new browser' = a browser context with no localStorage for the site. 'open' = load the page and wait for GET /api/profile to answer.
parts_rule: parts = speechParts(reply, lang) (server/tts.js, the producer the page reads from, as FX-013); each part -> POST /api/speak {text, lang} in order, the next sent after the previous answered (unless the case says 'queued')
